provenance: Manually authored synthetic regression seed by the project authoring assistant; NOT real university data, NOT expert-validated. Gold negatives default to no_match and positives were explicitly assigned. Review labels before using for model selection.
splitPolicy: 8 development courses and 8 distinct test courses. Do not tune thresholds on the test split.

modules.name: Linear Algebra
modules.description: Linear algebra with vector spaces, matrices, linear equations, eigenvalues, eigenvectors and matrix factorizations.

modules.name: Probability and Statistics
modules.description: Random variables and probability distributions, statistical estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and regression.

modules.name: Algorithms and Data Structures
modules.description: Data structures including trees, graphs and hash tables; sorting, searching, graph algorithms and asymptotic complexity analysis.

modules.name: Database Systems
modules.description: Relational data models, SQL queries, normalization, transactions, indexing and practical database design.

modules.name: Machine Learning
modules.description: Supervised learning for classification and regression; model selection, cross-validation and evaluation of generalization.

modules.name: Software Engineering
modules.description: Software requirements analysis, modular design, version control, unit testing, integration testing and team software development.

courses.name: Linear Algebra
courses.description: Vector spaces, matrices, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Singular value decomposition and matrix factorizations.

courses.name: Probability and Statistics
courses.description: Random variables and distributions. Statistical estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and linear regression.

courses.name: Data Structures
courses.description: Trees, graphs, hash tables, sorting and searching. Graph traversal algorithms and asymptotic time and space complexity analysis.

courses.name: Database Systems
courses.description: Relational data modeling, SQL queries, normalization and transactions. Indexing and practical database design with a SQL project.

courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.description: Supervised classification and regression. Model selection, cross-validation and generalization evaluation. Implement learning algorithms and linear regression in Python.

courses.name: Software Engineering
courses.description: Requirements analysis and modular software design. Version control, unit and integration testing and a team software development project.

courses.name: Data Visualization
courses.description: Color theory, chart types, dashboards and visual communication. Students create interactive plots and present visual stories from existing data.

courses.name: Introduction to Probability
courses.description: Random variables, discrete and continuous probability distributions and conditional probability. No statistical estimation or hypothesis testing is taught.

courses.name: Mathematical Methods
courses.description: Vector spaces and matrix algebra, linear systems, eigenvectors and eigenvalues. Matrix factorizations and numerical applications.

courses.name: Statistical Inference
courses.description: Probability distributions and random variables, parameter estimation, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and regression analysis.

courses.name: Efficient Algorithms
courses.description: Asymptotic complexity analysis, sorting, search, trees, graph algorithms and hash tables. Implementation and analysis of efficient algorithms.

courses.name: Information Management
courses.description: Conceptual entity-relationship diagrams and relational modeling. Students discuss normalization. SQL programming, transactions and indexing are outside this course.

courses.name: Deep Learning
courses.description: Neural network classification and regression using gradient descent and backpropagation. Model selection and cross-validation are not covered.

courses.name: Software Testing
courses.description: Unit testing, integration testing, test case design and automated test execution. Software requirements and modular architecture are outside the scope.

courses.name: History of Computing
courses.description: Historical development of computing institutions, biographies of pioneers and social impacts of digital technology. No technical programming or algorithm implementation.

courses.name: Python Programming
courses.description: Variables, loops, functions, object-oriented syntax, debugging and basic scripts. The course does not cover data structures, algorithm analysis or software project design.
